Basic setup for host disease dynamics (EIR forced)

Source: R/xds_setup.R
xds_setup_eir.Rd

Build a dynamical system to describe human malaria epidemiology or host disease dynamics forced by the daily EIR. The function encodes the model as an xds object that can be solved by xds_solve or xds_solve_cohort.

To build a model that is forced by infective biting in the patches, which requires setting up a time spent matrix and search weigths, use xds_setup_human.

Usage

xds_setup_eir(
  eir = 1/365,
  F_season = F_one,
  F_trend = F_one,
  F_shock = F_one,
  F_age = F_one,
  season_par = list(),
  trend_par = list(),
  shock_par = list(),
  age_par = list(),
  xds = "ode",
  XHname = "SIS",
  XHoptions = list(),
  HPop = 1000,
  model_name = "unnamed"
)

Arguments

eir

is the average, daily entomological inoculation rate

F_season

the seasonal pattern function

F_trend

the trend function

F_shock

the shock function

F_age

the relative biting rate by age

season_par

a list of options for F_season

trend_par

a list of options for F_trend

shock_par

a list of options for F_shock

age_par

a list of options for F_age

xds

is ode or dde or dts for ordinary OR delay differential OR difference equations

XHname

the name of an XH module (see XH_module_list)

XHoptions

a named list to set parameter values and initial conditions for the XH module

HPop

the initial human population density for each stratum

model_name

is a name for the model (arbitrary)

Value

an xds object

Details

A modified version of xds_setup that sets up a model to study exposure and infection. The MY component module is set to trivial and a trace function computes infective biting in the patches.

class(xds_obj$frame) = 'eir'

to dispatch functions that compute derivatives (xde), update variables (dts), and parse outputs.

Dynamics

Configure the XH component:

  • XHname — the name of an XH module: see the XH_module_list for human / host infection dynamics

  • HPop — the initial human population density

  • XHoptions sets parameter values and initial conditions for the XH module

  • nHostSpecies\(=1\)

The structural parameter nStrata is set to length(HPop).

The EIR Trace Function

The interface includes options to configure a composed, multiplicative time series function describing F_eir as a function of time. For cohort dynamics (using xds_solve_cohort), a function can be configured to compute relative biting rates by age:

  • eir — the average daily EIR (for each population stratum)

  • F_season or season_par — set up the seasonal pattern function

  • F_trend or trend_par — set up the trend pattern function

  • F_shock or shock_par — set up the shock function

  • F_age or age_par — set up relative biting rates by age

Next

  • To solve the model, see xds_solve or xds_solve_cohort

  • To check or change parameters, see xds_info_change_parameters

  • To check or change the initial conditions, see xds_info_initial_conditions
